en: From "Danball Senki W" comes Hiro Ozora's LBX Achilles D9! Restored with the original Runner specifications intact!

● 1/1 LBX Achilles D9 is back! The color coding of the main body is reproduced with molding colors and seals. ● Reproduce the cloak with paper craft! ● The sword bit is removable! ● "Hauteclair " and " Durandal " are included! ● You can recreate the special function " sword bit " by posing! It is also possible to reproduce the " Double Ray Wing" by linking it with the separately sold Odin Mk-2.
